searchText: Hi, I just realized I still have 2 validator clients attesting for holesky. Should I leave them up or take them down? it'd be great if you can submit an exit and then leave them on till they process, or if the wait is too long for you - then feel free to take it down They've actually already been marked to exit automatically by the network back when the Pectra incident happened. I kept them up running as part of the effort to get back finalization and kinda forgot about them. I don't mind keeping them up. It's just the teku client, not even the node since many of us couldn't get our nodes to sync after restart. Would you happen to know where to check to see when they'll exit? http://holesky.beaconcha.in/ doesn't seem to load.
